senses.gloss: (Pilp. of זוּעַ) to move, shake, agitate, trouble.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:28">Ex. R. s. 15</cite>, end <he>ז׳ את הימים וכ׳</he> He stirred the seas up and showed to him (Moses) &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2:4">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אני מְזַעֲזֵעַ עולמי</he> I will make my world quake.

<cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 1:3">Orl. I, 3</cite> <he>זִיעֲזַעְתּוֹ המחרישה</he> the ploughshare loosened it (the roots of the tree); <he>זִיעֲזָעוֹ ועשאו בעפר</he> he (the husbandman) lifted the tree and placed it in soft earth (v. comment.).

<cite ref="Shevuot 39a">Shebu. 39ᵃ</cite>. Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵇ <he>נִזְדַּעְזְעָה החומה</he> the wall was removed from its place; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 82b">B. Kam. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>נז׳ א״י</he> Palestine quaked.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:7:5">Cant. R. to III, 7</cite> <he>מתיראין ומִזְדַּעְזְעִין וכ׳</he> were frightened and shaken; a. fr.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 763:14">Yalk. Num. 763</cite> <he>שנזדעזעו בני המדינה</he> against whom the inhabitants of the country rebelled; a. fr.—Contracted part. <cite ref="M00722"><he>מִזְדַּנְזִין</he></cite>, or <cite ref="M00722"><he>מִזְדַּנְדְּזִין</he></cite> (= <he>מזדעזעין</he>).
<cite ref="Chullin 48a">Ḥull. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>התלמידים מזדנז׳ בדבר</he> ed. (Ar. <he>מזדנדז׳</he>) the students oppose it.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 8</cite> <he>אתה הִזְדַּעְזַעְתָּ … אֶזְדַּעְזֵעַ וכ׳</he> thou hast made thy limbs tremble …, so will I make my world quake, v. supra.
